critical_code_review_comments: services_catalog._generate_service_image_bytes uses os.environ['EMERGENT_LLM_KEY'] (KeyError if unset). Wrap with os.environ.get + 500 error like other services.
generate-missing-images runner uses asyncio.get_event_loop().create_task — deprecated in Py3.10+; prefer asyncio.create_task() inside a running loop or a BackgroundTasks dependency.
InvoiceIn.tax_pct default 18.0 is hardcoded — should come from tenant settings for GST correctness across tenants.
